stalker.limitations: Connectivity/bounds/differences do not prove anatomy or absence of visual defects. Small angle is a review signal, not automatic failure.

proximalExclusionAudit.interpretation: A candidate is not automatic failure: adjacent attachment tissues can naturally touch. However, old 0.13-unit discs must not hide protruding root lobes from human review. Actual torso alpha only is the strict visibility mask.

sleeper.scope: Saved sprite RGBA/rects/PPU, body only. Separate runtime eye layers and AI timing require root Unity validation.
sleeper.warning: Different PPU values alone do not prove an error. At final Recoil00 to Walk00 selection, saved world rect grows 30.1% in width and 52.4% in height. This is a static saved-sprite discontinuity; Play timing is not newly reproduced by this script.
